description: Use this when the human asks for shorter, longer, or friendlier email from Cooper. Requires auth. Sets the account default (omit owner_id; needs an unscoped key with owner_manage) or one owner's style (inbox_id and owner_id). Inputs: style (concise, detailed, casual, or null to inherit), note (optional plain text up to 280 characters, or null to clear), inbox_id and owner_id (optional). Every Cooper email to owners (digest, approval request, owner updates, confirmations, recovery, send-mode notices) follows the effective style. A style the owner chose from the Change email style link in their email cannot be changed here: 409 owner_style_locked. Cooper never puts the note into an email. Returns the same shape as cooper_get_owner_preferences.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id, username, or address. Needed with owner_id.

note.description: Optional plain-text preference for the agent, at most 280 characters. null clears it.

owner_id.description: Owner id (own_…). Omit to set the account default.

style.description: concise (default), detailed, or casual. null clears it so the owner inherits the account default.

name: cooper_set_owner_preferences
title: Set owner email style
